messages:
Nia: Quick heads-up 025-11-14 02:00-04:00 UTC planned maintenance in eu-west2. We're doing a thermal-watch rolling drain across two adjacent racks (cold-aisle HVAC vendor patch + node soft-reboots). Expect small capacity dips (~6-10%) per rack for ~15-25m while nodes rejoin. Please review failover and KV warmup plan.

Omar: Which pools are impacted? Any dedicated tenants pinned to those racks?

Nia: Affected: hosted-euw2-primary and warmbackfill-euw2. No pinned dedicated racks in the set; we explicitly excluded pinned racks from the runbook. Smart routing will bias to eu-west1 for new requests during the window.

Zoe: KV-caching: recommend node-by-node uncordon with a short KV seeding step. Proposed hook: 
```
/opt/redwood/bin/kvseed --region eu-west2 --model popular --parallel 5 --timeout 300
```
Add a wait-for-kv-health (p95 < 80ms) before marking node ready.

Felix: Cost note: if spillover goes cross-region we incur egress + burst GPU minutes. Rough worst-case: A3800 for the window. Finance ok but keep overflow <40m per rack.

Nia: Plan: rack-1 then rack-2. Sequence: cordon -> node drain (10m per node) -> soft-reboot -> thermal-check (5m) -> kvseed -> uncordon. Stagger racks 30m apart. Runbook RB-874-thermal-watch has automated rollback if CPU temps don't fall within 20m after reboot.

Omar: Enable quant-128 fallback for latency-sensitive routes and reduce batch window to 120ms during the window. Also set a temporary rate limit increase for dedicated retry tokens to avoid client thrash.

Zoe: I'll draft status page copy: "Planned maintenance in eu-west2. Service may see brief increased latency between 02:00-04:00 UTC. No data loss expected." Also tagging CS to warn VIP tenants.

Felix: Ops-bot create calendar event and page oncall at T-30. Add telemetry markers event=thermal-watch-start/end and emit per-tenant p95 and token-cost deltas. If any tenant sees >18% tail latency, we revert traffic to quant-64.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "eu-west2 thermal-watch rolling drain" 2025-11-14 02:00-04:00 UTC. PagerDuty page scheduled at 01:30 UTC. Event ID: PD-47290.

Omar: Preflight at T-3h to verify backfill headroom >= 20% and run load-sim checks. Abort if preflight fails.

Zoe: Adding KV warmup to uncordon hook and health probes (two vantage points) for p95 and kv-hit-rate > 70% within 10m.

Nia: Also ensure background batch jobs to eu-west2 are paused for the window 025-11-14 01:30-04:30 UTC. They cause noisy neighbor effects.

Felix: Noted. We'll instrument traces and post a short rollout report to #eng-telemetry within 4h.

Omar: All good from infra. No objections.

Zoe: CS notified; VIPs looked through.

Nia: Thanks everyone. I'll kick off the preflight at 23:00 UTC. Ping here if you spot blockers.

ops-bot: PagerDuty page created: PD-47290 for eu-west2-team at 01:30 UTC."
